posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Laferu said:
Do you know how I can do this in Action Sequences?
I thought this plugin was only for scripted movements; in my case, I need the deflection actions to be executed by pressing a button at the right time.
Click to expand...
The projectile is still a scripted movement. You simply have to code in the timed input. Now, I'm not using MZ, so I sadly can't tell you if there's a plugin similar to SRDs sequence input plugin, or if you'll have to manually event it. (In action sequencing in MZ you can use all the common event event command after all, completely possible.)
You may also need a projectile plugin for battle animations, but that is probably already included in the visustella stuff.
It's not gonna be a plug and play thing and you'll likely have to do some looping and some rng variable rolling to determine whether or not the enemy hits the projectile back again or not, but it's definitely possible.
